subject: general
question: Which of the following layers contains ozone?
solution:
The Correct Answer is **Stratosphere.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The **ozone layer** is primarily located in the lower portion of the **stratosphere**, from approximately** 20 to 30 kilometers above Earth,** although its thickness varies seasonally and geographically.
 
• **Ozone molecules absorb ultraviolet (UV) radiation from the Sun,** particularly harmful UVB-type rays, thus protecting living organisms on Earth from these dangerous rays.
 
• The **presence of the ozone layer is crucial for life on Earth** as it prevents most of the Sun's high-frequency ultraviolet radiation from reaching the planet's surface.
 
• Human activities have caused ozone depletion, particularly by releasing chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs) into the atmosphere, leading to the creation of the ozone hole over Antarctica.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 1) Troposphere
 The lowest layer of Earth's atmosphere, where weather phenomena occur. It extends from Earth's surface up to about 8-15 kilometers. Ozone concentration here is much lower.
 
 

 2) Stratosphere
 Contains the ozone layer. This layer extends from about 15 to about 50 kilometers above Earth's surface. It is where commercial airplanes often fly.
 
 

 3) Thermosphere
 Located above the mesosphere, extending from about 85 kilometers to 600 kilometers high. It is characterized by a rapid increase in temperature with height.
 
 

 4) Mesosphere
 The layer above the stratosphere and below the thermosphere, extending from about 50 to 85 kilometers above Earth. It is the coldest atmospheric layer.
